description: Wallet 與 Auditor：同一個朋友函式宣告在兩個類別裡、朋友類別有類別外定義的成員。⚠️ 出題者的原稿編不過（audit 寫 Auditor 的私有欄位卻沒有宣告成它的朋友），補了那一行原型，其餘未動。
A Vec2 class with friend functions returning a reference, a pointer and a Vec2 by value, plus a friend operator<< defined outside the class.
A Library/Book/Member system where a Member member function is a friend of Book and a friend helper is defined inline inside Library.
A Matrix and a MatrixOps friend class in an inventory-like simulation, with a namespace-qualified friend function declared between members.
